front: Which AWS resources in a typical lab bill hourly even when idle?
back: NAT gateways (~$0.045/h + data), load balancers, EKS control planes (~$0.10/h), public IPv4 addresses (~$0.005/h each) and running compute (EC2, Fargate tasks). VPCs, subnets, route tables, IGWs, SGs and IAM are free.

front: Three commands to start a Terraform session with IAM Identity Center
back: `aws sso login --profile learn-admin`, `export AWS_PROFILE=learn-admin`, `aws sts get-caller-identity` (confirm the account before applying).
A `[profile ...]` section (account ID, role name, region, `sso_session`) and an `[sso-session ...]` section (start URL, SSO region, scopes) in `~/.aws/config`. No long-lived keys.
A block in the AWS provider whose tags are merged into every taggable resource created by that provider block. Each alias needs its own.

front: Two ways to create a resource in a second region with AWS provider v6
back: A provider alias (`provider "aws" { alias = "use1" region = "us-east-1" }` + `provider = aws.use1`) or the per-resource `region` argument.
`10.0.1.0/24` — add 8 bits to the prefix (/16 → /24) and take network number 1.

front: What makes a subnet public vs private?
back: Public: its route table sends 0.0.0.0/0 to an internet gateway. Private: no IGW route; outbound only via NAT gateway or VPC endpoints.

front: Why key subnets with `for_each` over AZ names instead of `count`?
back: Instances are addressed by stable keys (`aws_subnet.public["eu-central-1a"]`), so adding or removing an AZ doesn't shift indexes and replace other subnets.

front: Task execution role vs task role (ECS)
back: Execution role: used by ECS to pull images, write logs and fetch secrets. Task role: assumed by your application code for its own AWS API calls.

front: What does Terraform do to a security group's default egress rule?
back: It removes AWS's default allow-all egress rule. Declare egress explicitly (e.g. `aws_vpc_security_group_egress_rule`).

Public access block (all 4 true), ownership controls `BucketOwnerEnforced`, SSE encryption, versioning, lifecycle (noncurrent expiry, abort multipart), bucket policy denying `aws:SecureTransport = false`.
`ListBucket` acts on the bucket ARN `arn:aws:s3:::name`; `GetObject` acts on object ARNs `arn:aws:s3:::name/*`.

front: Fargate task stops with `CannotPullContainerError ... i/o timeout`. First suspect?
back: No network path to the registry: private subnet without NAT/VPC endpoints, public subnet without `assign_public_ip`, or no egress rule.

front: What changed in LocalStack in March 2026?
back: Community image discontinued and repo archived; one image that needs a free account + `LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN`. Free Hobby plan: non-commercial, subset of services (no ECS/ECR at the time of writing), no IAM enforcement.
Makes apply wait until the service's deployment is stable, so a crash-looping task fails the apply instead of reporting success.
